name: Don't Wake the 99 Nights in the Forest!
desc:
Welcome to Don't Wake the 99 Nights in the Forest!

Shh... Don't wake the The Deer! 🤫

😴 Sneak around and steal kids and more while they sleep! 
🏃‍♂️ Escape when you wake them up and they start chasing! 
⚡ Survive and collect as many kids and more charachters as possible!

👍Like the game to show your support! 
⭐Make sure to favorite the game to not miss any update
